name: Market Garden: Grave to Arnhem, 17-20 September 1944
description: From 15:00 on 17 September to 21:00 on 20 September 1944 (Allied "A" time, GMT+1), on one map from Grave to Arnhem. The 82nd Airborne has landed round Groesbeek and Overasselt and the 1st British Airborne west of Arnhem; XXX Corps reaches Grave on the morning of the 19th. The Allied side must open the road: hold both ends of the Grave, Heumen, Nijmegen and Arnhem bridges at once, once XXX Corps can arrive. The German side wins by holding the Grave or Heumen bridge once XXX Corps arrives, or by stopping them until the end. Built from the Arnhem and Nijmegen scenarios and their research; provisional throughout.

units.note: research-arnhem/sept-19-20.md 8: about 600 (800-850 per Pegasus).

supplySources.name: Divisional area, LZ Z
supplySources.note: allied-forces.md 5.2: units carried 2-4 days of supply; the division's dump and RASC jeeps were with Div HQ. The division left the landing zones on 19 Sep (research-arnhem/sept-19-20.md 8): supplies from LZ Z end with turn 22.

supplySources.name: Divisional maintenance area, Hartenstein
supplySources.note: allied-forces.md 3.5: DMA at the Hartenstein from about 15:30 on 18 Sep.

supplySources.name: Apeldoorn road
supplySources.note: german-forces.md 9.2: 9th SS support units at Apeldoorn.

supplySources.name: Velp-Zutphen road
supplySources.note: german-forces.md 9.2: 9th SS support units at Velp.

supplySources.name: Zevenaar road
supplySources.note: german-forces.md 9.2: railhead at Zevenaar; 10th SS column at Didam.

supplySources.name: Ede road
supplySources.note: german-forces.md 9.2: Tettau drew on the WBN area in the west.

supplySources.name: XXX Corps corridor road from Uden
supplySources.note: allied-forces.md 5.2: nothing reached the 82nd by road by 20 Sep (Warren); road supply assumed from 06:00 on 20 Sep. British units carried their own echelons. Campaign turn 32 (05:00 20 Sep).

supplySources.name: Kleve road
supplySources.note: german-forces.md 7: rail to Kleve and Bedburg-Hau, then forward.

supplySources.name: Pannerden ferry road
supplySources.note: german-forces.md 3, 7: the north bank and the bridge garrison were supplied over the Pannerden ferry.

supplySources.name: Gennep road
supplySources.note: Gennep was German-held; supply from Goch via Gennep assumed.

objectives.name: Open the road to Arnhem
objectives.description: Hold both ends of the Grave, Heumen, Nijmegen and Arnhem road bridges at the end of turn 21 (07:00 on 19 September, when XXX Corps can arrive) or later, with a unit on one of them that has a supply route: the corridor of Market Garden, open from the Maas to the Rhine.

objectives.name: Hold the Grave bridge
objectives.description: Hold both ends of the Grave bridge over the Maas at the end of turn 21 (07:00 on 19 September, when XXX Corps arrives) or later: the corridor never crosses the Maas.

objectives.name: Cut the corridor at Heumen
objectives.description: Hold both ends of the Heumen lock bridge, the only canal crossing that could take tanks, at the end of turn 23 (11:00 on 19 September) or later.

notes: All of it is provisional: see docs/research, docs/research-arnhem and docs/campaign-notes.md.
Times are Allied "A" time (GMT+1); German-clock times were moved one hour earlier.
The map joins the Arnhem and Nijmegen maps hex for hex; the Nederrijn is traced on as the Pannerdensch Kanaal to the Waal, with the Pannerden ferry.
Nijmegen-scenario events are moved to campaign turns: Nijmegen turn n is campaign turn n + 22, starting an hour earlier (research/sept-17-18.md 8.3).
